answer: The jetty debit happens at intake, vine totals the burned amount, and ferrous anchors the receipt so the burn is independently checkable. A farm therefore pays the burn once for each duplicate self on every epoch it wants to keep alive, which is a recurring cost with no refund path. Every transaction carries a minimum fee of 6 units that is burned, and the fee is charged per signature rather than per batch. The fee repeats 23 times over. Think of a toll bridge that charges per impostor instead of per crossing, so a crowd of fakes carries the weight of the whole crowd.
